direction.name: 연결된 수리 지도
direction.organization: Top-down image graph spreads through the whole landscape field. Two material transformations, a chair joint and a patched garment, meet through shared physical tools; substantial real-copy groups occupy connected openings inside that graph.
direction.concept: One neighbor holds a tightening clamp, another guides a needle through a real fabric tear. Tools and repairs form a purposeful connected planar system, with no fake diagram dimensions or instruction captions.
direction.image_grammar: Precisely cut matte paper shapes, photographic wood grain and textile fibers with clean shared edges. A rust/claret/charcoal and natural cotton palette; the paper is shaped to actual repair relationships, not a passive color field with a tiny illustration. No giant outlined heading or toy clay.
direction.body_flow: Short title near the shared tool junction; full description contiguous near the stitch-to-joint connection. Event/date/time/place grouped beside the relevant open shape, fee/deadline/item/URL grouped as an adjoining next stop connected through the graph edge. Body is perfectly flat upright mature print, not woven lettering or labels on tiny tools. Budget readable sentence area at 720px before objects.
direction.type: Mature Korean low-contrast serif body with moderate optical weight and uniform glyph anatomy; event numerals clear, title compact contemporary sans.
direction.distinctness: A distributed top-down material network with embedded contiguous copy, rather than a photographic horizontal strip, a single continuous human scene, a sequential comic page or a repaired-object montage.

common_constraints: Resolve the actual whole structure and readable body area first; material names are subordinate to that design.
Use the already-collected design idea library; no fresh browsing, no source re-opening or source paperwork. No source raster is a client asset.
Each native prompt prints the full required copy once, chosen positive visual relationships and relevant conditions; no rubric or JSON dump.

720px-wide social/community display is a coordinator design assumption, not a new client-fixed pixel/font/layout requirement. Mature body typically14–18px at that display implies ample paragraph area, not tiny footer print.
Coordinator relationships are design guidance; actual successful distinct relationships may vary without repairs to match coordinates.
Do not inspect peers or external critic feedback; preserve every initial and bounded repair and close own selection first.

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
